# Bloodgeon

Internal ID: MaceEldnerBlood | Type: Club | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x24, Bloodstone x3 | Attack speed: 1.72 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.5 range, 30 angle, 0.8 height, 0.3 ray, vertical | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

Bloodgeon is the upgraded form of Flametal mace using the Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
An upgraded Bloodgeon will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
